## Email domain

The domain part of the address that was refused (you do not need to include
the full address if you would prefer not to).

## What the error said

Paste or describe the message shown at registration.

## Why you believe the address is legitimate

For example: it is a personal or work domain, it has been in use for some time,
you can receive mail at it right now.

## Additional context

Anything else that may help resolve the block quickly.
